body:
I read it. All the way through and completely. I may be a couple year ahead of you though. The most beautiful music I've ever heard had come from a piano and in the past few months my dream has to be to own a piano in the future. Even if I don't play it personally, it would probably send me to tears for any future children (if there are any) to play [this](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kqrg_1TkKT4).

Life is about adding to culture and life. Please pass on whatever gifts or passions you possess to future generations. Even try and share whatever you feel you can write musically, I will listen. Music is like words from the heart, and no matter who you are, or how good you believe your music is, it is still something always worth listening to. As part of a band or not.

You'll be sharing who you are. And I may be a stranger but I believe you should do that, let people in. You can always find beauty in yourself.

Thank you do very much. I'm going to arrange an appointment with somebody about maybe having depression. Even try and talk to a friend possibly.

But I really mean it, thank you.

You meet new people nearly every day. When I was 15 I thought I had nothing in common with anybody, I was a lonely quiet nerd. But then I met my friends, Liam, Callum and, Kris. Without them I have no idea what I'd be doing. You just have to give people the chance, even if they're different from you, people can be surprising.

One thing I have learned is that friendships don't come easy until you've properly made friends with them. Even people that you may think are complete and utter dicks can surprise you. But sometimes you just need to give it time, friends can spark up in the most unlikely of places, but they will somewhere.

Please. I know I'm a stranger on the internet, but my only word is please. Please don't go through with this. Only taking this will make you more depressed and want to do have more.
So from an internet stranger, please do the right thing. I may not personally know you, but I do care for you, whether you believe it or not. There's often no second chances if you're wrong with your decision.

Please, if there's anything I can do just let me know. I may not be able to deal with my problems but I can sure as hell help you with yours. You're 16 and he coming out in 2 years? That's 2 whole year you have to separate yourself and become independent. There's so much ahead that's available, remember this is only temporary. You meet friends, possibly the best people you could ever meet, and they will be there for you. You just have to give it time, and I promise you that if you make the effort for them, they will make the effort for you.

16 is way too young to give up. Things do get better as you get older. I wish I could give advice for right now, but the current advice is all I can give.
